summary.text: Kayla Santosuosso represents the 47th District on the New York City Council, which covers Bay Ridge, Coney Island, Sea Gate and parts of Dyker Heights, Bath Beach and Gravesend in southern Brooklyn.
Her Council biography describes her as an attorney and former small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Santosuosso is the child of small business owners, and her Council biography says she has served the public since her teens, including managing a nonprofit for new immigrants, working in philanthropy during law school and litigating as a city attorney.
She has lived in Bay Ridge for over a decade, and she and her husband owned a bar and restaurant there.
She also worked for former Council Member Justin Brannan, according to the biography.
Her stated priorities include quality-of-life issues, universal childcare and support for small businesses.
